mapper.sql: id, user_id, type, amount, category, account_type, record_date, remark, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY record_date DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO record (user_id, type, amount, category, account_type, record_date, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{category}, #{accountType}, #{recordDate}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM record_date) AS recordMonth, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense FROM record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM record_date) = #{year} GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM record_date) ORDER BY recordMonth
